heading: SFF Static Digital Frequency Relay - Legacy

text: Manufacturing for this product has been discontinued. As an alternative, please refer to the 3 Series relays.
heading: SFF Static Digital Frequency Relay - Legacy

text: Type SFF relays are digital frequency relays designed to operate when the system frequency changes to a predetermined level. They may be set for over-, under-, or restore- frequency operation. Versions are available with one, two, or four frequency points independently settable for function, frequency value, and output delay.
